using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
// other usings

namespace Jellyfin.Api.Middleware.Tests;

public class IPBasedAccessValidationMiddlewareTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Invoke_BlockedRemoteIP_LogsWarningAndReturns503()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockNext = new Mock<RequestDelegate>();
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware>>();
        var mockNetworkManager = new Mock<INetworkManager>();
        mockNetworkManager.Setup(x => x.ShouldAllowServerAccess(It.IsAny<EndPoint>()))
            .Returns(RemoteAccessPolicyResult.Deny); // assuming enum value

        var middleware = new IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware(mockNext.Object, mockLogger.Object);

        var httpContext = new DefaultHttpContext();
        httpContext.Request.Path = "/test";
        httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress = new IPAddress(new byte[] { 8,8,8,8 });

        // Act
        await middleware.Invoke(httpContext, mockNetworkManager.Object);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(
            It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Blocking request to {Path}")),
            It.IsAny<object[]>(),
            Times.Once));
        
        // More precise verification would capture the arguments
        mockNetworkManager.Verify(x => x.ShouldAllowServerAccess(It.IsAny<EndPoint>()), Times.Once);
        Assert.Equal(503, httpContext.Response.StatusCode);
        mockNext.Verify(x => x(It.IsAny<HttpContext>()), Times.Never);
    }
}
